label: PF Backlog 561
title: Defect/RCCA: scripts/dev/single_path_check.py crashes when core.paths.ROOT is a Path (TypeError on _ROOT.replace)
body:
## Problem / why
`scripts/dev/single_path_check.py:45` calls `_ROOT.replace("\\","/")`; `core.paths.ROOT` is now a `Path`,
so `Path.replace()` has a different signature -> `TypeError: Path.replace() takes 2 positional arguments but
3 were given`. The gate crashes (exit 1) whenever it runs.

## 5-Why
1. The gate crashed on `_ROOT.replace(...)`.
2. `_ROOT` is a `Path`, not `str`.
3. The script assumed a str root and never normalized.
4. `core.paths.ROOT` changed to `Path`; the script was not updated.
5. The gate only runs when `enhance`/`worker` files changed, so the break was latent.
ROOT CAUSE: type drift (ROOT str -> Path) without normalizing consumers.

## Corrective
`_ROOT = str(_ROOT)` right after import (one line).

## Guard
The gate now runs and passes; it is part of `precheck` (area enhance/worker). Follow-up: audit other
`ROOT.replace(...)`-style consumers for the same Path/str drift.

## Acceptance
`python scripts/dev/single_path_check.py` exits 0.
